description: This script generates a Kconfig file for Petalinux by parsing recipe information, managing directories, and performing sanity checks. It includes functions for formatting Kconfig entries, handling external commands, and integrating with build tools.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Appends a string to the output Kconfig file.

methods.name: sanity_test
methods.description: Runs a bitbake command to verify the Kconfig setup and logs the result.

methods.name: rename_dir
methods.description: Renames a directory if it exists, used for backup purposes.

methods.name: kconfig_recipe_format
methods.description: Formats recipe data into Kconfig entries and writes them to the output file.

methods.name: get_exclude_pkgs
methods.description: Reads exclude package patterns from a JSON file.

methods.name: plnxkconfig
methods.description: Main function to generate the Kconfig file by parsing recipes, managing directories, and optionally running sanity checks.

methods.name: register_commands
methods.description: Registers CLI commands for generating the Kconfig file.
